opponent.label: Tristana
opponent.description:
Standing tall (for a yordle), Tristana never backs down from a fight. With her trusty cannon, Boomer, at her side, she fiercely defends Bandle City from any and all threats that may come its way.

But being the fearless leader of the Bandle Gunners doesn't leave a girl much time for some R&R. Searching for a different kind of action, and a well-overdue break from training rookies, Tristana rocket-jumps into the inventory, hoping to get her hands on some truly "high-caliber" weaponry.
